title: Signed row comparison for one concrete first-page quotient
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be Grothendieck abelian categories [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian, def-sp-abelian], and let $F:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and left exact [def-sp-left-exact-additive]. Let $I$ be a bicomplex indexed by $s\in\mathbf Z$ and $r\in\mathbf N$, with $I^s=0$ for $s<b$ for some $b\in\mathbf Z$. Form the mapped extended flipped bicomplex $J$ [def-sp-cartan-eilenberg-presentation]. Let $L$ be a decreasing subcomplex filtration of $\operatorname{Tot}(J)$ [def-sp-filtration] whose degreewise steps equal the second-filtration sums [def-sp-double-complex-total]. Let $D$ be any FilteredComplexPageDifferential for this filtered total at page 1 [lem-sp-filtered-complex-page-differential]; in particular its objects are the actual cokernels $Q_1^{s,r}=\operatorname{coker}(B_1^{s,r}\hookrightarrow Z_1^{s,r})$ [def-sp-filtered-complex-subquotients], and its differential is specified on representatives by $z\mapsto dz$. There are isomorphisms $e_{r,s}:Q_1^{s,r}\cong H^r(F(I^s))$ for all $r\in\mathbf N$, $s\in\mathbf Z$, satisfying $D.d_{(s,r),(s+1,r)}e_{r,s+1}=(-1)^r e_{r,s}H^r(F(I.d_{s,s+1}))$. This assertion concerns one concrete page and has no spectral-sequence existence or higher-page assertion.

proof.text: Put J = flip(mappedFunctor F(I)) and n = s+r. Lift the diagonal coprojection J^(r,s) -> Tot(J)^n through the monomorphism L^s K^n -> K^n. This is possible since the image of that coprojection is one of the summands of the second-filtration step. The projection of this lift to gr^s L is an isomorphism: the projection from the total coproduct to J^(r,s) restricts to L^s and kills L^(s+1), and gives its inverse. Check the two identities on each diagonal coprojection. The finite interval [s,n] is exactly the surviving diagonal range, since the resolution coordinate n-j is nonnegative. The lower bound on the complex coordinate permits finite diagonal coproducts, including negative s.

The total differential on the chosen diagonal inclusion is its resolution differential plus (-1)^r times its complex-coordinate differential. The latter lands in the next filtration step and is killed in gr^s L. Thus the isomorphisms of the previous step intertwine the graded differential and the row resolution differential. Apply the first-page cycles-boundaries identities to identify the filtered Z_1 and B_1 with that row differential kernel and image. Taking the cokernel of B_1 -> Z_1 gives the canonical row-homology isomorphism from the concrete page object. Extension by zero along Nat -> Int preserves homology at every natural degree; at r=0 the incoming term is zero.

Restrict the diagonal lift to the row-cycle object at r. Its resolution differential is zero, so its total differential is (-1)^r times the diagonal lift of the complex-coordinate map into the row at s+1. That image is a row cycle because the two bicomplex differentials commute. Substitute these lifts and their graded cycle classes into D.on_representatives. Compose with the canonical quotient comparisons and cancel the epimorphism from row cycles onto row homology. The resulting equation is exactly d_1 followed by the target comparison equals (-1)^r times the source comparison followed by homologyMap of F(I.d s (s+1)). The map of row cycles sends row boundaries to row boundaries since I.d is a chain map. Preadditivity moves the unit scalar through the quotient maps. No higher-page construction or arbitrary page-object isomorphism is used.

theorem secondFiltration_signed_firstPage
    {A : Type uA} [Category.{vA} A] [Abelian A] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vA} A]
    {B : Type uB} [Category.{vB} B] [Abelian B] [IsGrothendieckAbelian.{vB} B]
    (F : A ⥤ B) [F.Additive] [PreservesFiniteLimits F]
    (I : HomologicalComplex₂ A (ComplexShape.up ℤ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ))
    (hbelow : ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ s : ℤ, s < b → IsZero (I.X s))
    (L : DecreasingFiltration
      ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor F).obj I).flip).total
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)))
    (hL : ∀ p n : ℤ, L.complexStep p n =
      ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor F).obj I).flip).secondFiltration n).step
        p)
    (D : FilteredComplexPageDifferential
      ((((CartanEilenbergPresentation.mappedFunctor F).obj I).flip).total
        (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) L 1) :
    ∃ e : ∀ (r : ℕ) (s : ℤ), D.page.X (s, (r : ℤ)) ≅
        ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj (I.X s)).homology r,
      ∀ (r : ℕ) (s : ℤ),
        D.page.d (s, (r : ℤ)) (s + 1, (r : ℤ)) ≫ (e r (s + 1)).hom =
          (r : ℤ).negOnePow • ((e r s).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
            ((F.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).map (I.d s (s + 1))) r)
